correctness.rationale: For all even m,n>=4 and all real twists, the Lindblad HS identity excludes nonzero imaginary eigenvalues; connected noncancelling length-two diagonal paths force equal monitored block diagonals; the fixed algebra is exactly the bright scalar plus arbitrary odd dark algebra. Fourier zero modes satisfy two solvable linear congruences with gcd(m,n) solutions each and exactly two overlaps at zero flux. The resulting rank and return identities were recomputed analytically, and the packaged code passed 36 spectra/kernel/connectivity cases plus ten stationary density cases. No finite test is promoted to an all-size proof.
